headlines.title: Is ASML Holding (NasdaqGS:ASML) Getting Too Pricey For Its Cash Flow?
headlines.summary: ASML Holding has delivered a powerful long term share price run, yet the recent pullback raises a sharper question for you as an investor: how much of today’s valuation is actually supported by the cash the business can generate? With the stock still well above where it traded a few years ago, the real issue is whether those cash flows line up with the current price tag. Over the past 3 years the share price has gained 106.

headlines.title: Is ASML Holding (NasdaqGS:ASML) Undervalued After Its Recent Pullback?
headlines.summary: ASML Holding (ASML) has drawn fresh attention after recent share price weakness, with the stock down 17% over the past month and 21% in the past 3 months. That decline now shapes how investors evaluate its size and growth profile. The recent slide follows a much stronger stretch for ASML Holding, with the share price still up 18.85% year to date and the 1 year total shareholder return at 38.47%, so short term momentum has cooled even as longer term performance remains positive.

headlines.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of ASML (ASML) on Monday
headlines.summary: ETFs sold a net $46.9 million of ASML on Monday, with 10 buyers outweighing 5 sellers in count.

headlines.title: ASML Stocks Fall 2.72% as New US Rule Tightens the Chip Supply Chain It Serves
headlines.summary: The BIS rule adds licenses for five data center hubs and stricter foundry checks, while China makes up roughly 20% of ASML's 2026 revenue.

headlines.title: ASML vs. Lam Research: Which Chipmaking Stock is the Better Buy Now?
headlines.summary: ASML and LRCX are riding AI-driven chip demand, but differences in growth prospects, valuation and earnings estimates make one a better investment pick.

description: ASML Holding N.V. provides lithography solutions for the development, production, marketing, sales, upgrading, and servicing of advanced semiconductor equipment systems. The company offers lithography, metrology, and inspection systems. It also provides extreme ultraviolet lithography systems; and deep ultraviolet lithography systems comprising immersion and dry lithography systems solutions to manufacture various range of semiconductor nodes and technologies. In addition, the company offers metrology and inspection systems, including YieldStar optical metrology systems, a diffraction-based wafer metrology platform to assess the quality of patterns on the wafers; and HMI electron beam solutions to locate and analyze individual chip defects. Further, it provides computational lithography solutions, and lithography systems and control software solutions; and refurbishes and upgrades lithography systems, as well as offers customer support and related services. Additionally, the company offers hardware, software, and services to chipmakers to produce the patterns of integrated circuits. It operates in Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Taiwan, China, rest of Asia, the Netherlands, rest of Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the United States. The company was formerly known as ASM Lithography Holding N.V. and changed its name to ASML Holding N.V. in 2001. ASML Holding N.V. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Veldhoven, the Netherlands.
